headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw two touchdown passes to Jimmy Graham and the Seattle Seahawks added to their history of success in Arizona with a 22-16 victory over the Cardinals on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson throws 2 TD passes, Seahawks win again in Arizona

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Mark Ingram scored a career-best three touchdowns and the New Orleans Saints won their seventh straight game by plowing through a porous Buffalo Bills defense in a 47-10 rout on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ingram, Saints run up 47-10 win over porous Bills

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Brett Hundley threw for 212 yards and a touchdown, Nick Perry had three sacks and the Green Bay Packers beat the Chicago Bears 23-16 to snap a three-game losing streak on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers win first game without Rodgers, beat Bears 23-16

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford lofted a 29-yard, tiebreaking touchdown to Eric Ebron early in the fourth quarter and the Detroit Lions went on to beat the winless Cleveland Browns 38-24 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Stafford helps Lions come back and beat Browns 38-24

headlines.description: The Tennessee Titans are starting to show they can finish in style. The result is the best start for this franchise since 2008.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans rally, beat Bengals 24-20 for best start since 2008

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger's 32-yard completion to Antonio Brown with 35 seconds set up a 33-yard field goal from Chris Boswell as time expired Sunday, giving Pittsburgh a 20-17 come-from-behind win at Indianapolis on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Roethlisberger rallies Steelers to 20-17 win at Indianapolis

events.name: New York Jets at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Ryan Fitzpatrick led two long scoring drives and Tampa Bay limited the New York Jets to less than 200 yards of offense until late in the fourth quarter to snap a five-game losing streak with a 15-10 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fitzpatrick helps Bucs beat Jets 15-10, end 5-game skid

headlines.description: Case Keenum threw touchdowns to four different receivers to build a big lead, and the NFC North-leading Minnesota Vikings won their fifth in a row by beating the Washington Redskins 38-30 Sunday despite throwing two second-half interceptions.
headlines.shortLinkText: Keenum, Vikings keep rolling by beating Redskins 38-30

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: Josh Lambo kicked a 30-yard field goal with 3:12 remaining in overtime, lifting the Jacksonville Jaguars to a 20-17 victory against the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars rally to beat Chargers 20-17 in OT for 3rd straight

events.name: Houston Texans at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Robert Woods caught two of Jared Goff's three touchdown passes during a dominant third quarter, and the surging Los Angeles Rams returned after a month away from home for their fourth straight victory, 33-7 over the depleted Houston Texans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jared Goff leads Rams to 4th straight win, 33-7 over Texans

headlines.description: Adrian Clayborn set an Atlanta record with six sacks, Matt Ryan threw a pair of short touchdown passes and the Falcons romped to a 27-7 victory Sunday over the Dallas Cowboys, who played without suspended Ezekiel Elliott.
headlines.shortLinkText: Adrian Clayborn has 6 sacks, Falcons romp past Cowboys 27-7

events.name: New York Giants at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: C.J. Beathard threw for 288 yards and two touchdowns and ran for a third score to lead the San Francisco 49ers to their first win of the season with a 31-21 victory over the New York Giants on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beathard leads 49ers past Giants 31-21 for 1st win of season

events.name: New England Patriots at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw three touchdown passes and the New England Patriots matched their own AFC record with their 12th consecutive road victory, pummeling the Denver Broncos 41-16 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady, Patriots send Broncos to fifth straight loss, 41-16

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw for 254 yards and four touchdowns, rookie Christian McCaffrey scored touchdowns rushing and receiving, and the Carolina Panthers crushed the Miami Dolphins 45-21 on Monday night for their third straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton, Panthers hammer Dolphins 45-21 for 3rd straight win
